# clickup_task_dependency (Resource)

Manages a dependency between two ClickUp tasks. Use `depends_on_id` to make this task depend on another, or `dependency_of` to mark this task as a dependency of another.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `task_id` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `dependency_of` (String)
- `depends_on_id` (String)
